transcript: Hello I am Faruji, I want to be DevOps Engineer. I studied IT but still learning. I used Linux and AWS in one job portal. It was recruitment. I done small part only like ad page check errors. It was not being. I think I can work if someone guide. My talking is not best.

This would help you to showcase your skills and knowledge more effectively.
strengths: showing eagerness to learn and work
having some experience with relevant tools like Linux and AWS
weaknesses: lack of clarity in expressing thoughts

suggestions: practice speaking about your experiences in a structured way

better_answer_example: In my previous role, I had the opportunity to work with Linux and AWS on a recruitment project. Although my part was small, I was responsible for checking ad pages for errors. I learned a lot about the importance of attention to detail and how to use these tools efficiently. With guidance, I am confident I can take on more complex tasks and contribute to a team as a DevOps Engineer.
